guitar.modelsText: Gibson Flying V (black and white 'Boogie Body' V)
models: Gibson Flying V (black and white 'Boogie Body' V)
guitar.evidence: Michael Schenker is one of the most iconic Flying V players in rock history, with his black-and-white V being his signature look, well documented.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with high confidence given the genuinely iconic, well-documented instrument.

tone.target: aggressive hard-rock crunch with lead sustain
tone.profile: aggressive hard-rock crunch with lead sustain
tone.summary: Gate 1 -> Boost -> Distortion (RAT) -> UK 45 Amp -> UK Vintage 4x12 Cab -> Guitar EQ 2 -> Tremolo -> Room
corrections: Push toward raw lead crunch, not generic rock

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and excessive noise inherent in high-gain hard rock tones.
Provide a controlled mid-hump and boost the signal into the distortion stage for lead sustain.
blocks.gap: The 'Boost' model is used to simulate a light, aggressive overdrive/boost effect without adding excessive coloration, fulfilling the 'light overdrive or boost' clue.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core aggressive crunch and slight fuzz texture required for hard rock lead tones.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style model is ideal for raw, mid-focused grit that characterizes classic hard rock leads, matching the 'slight fuzz' requirement better than pure distortion.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the desired British Plexi/Marshall style amp tone, providing upper mids and tight drive.
Provide the necessary British cabinet voicing and punch for hard rock rhythm and lead tones.
Aggressively boost the upper mids to achieve the 'British upper mids' and cut unnecessary low-end mud.
Add subtle movement and dimension to the lead notes without sounding like a wash (avoiding chorus/delay).
Provide a subtle sense of space and sustain for the lead notes without excessive wash.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal focus by swapping the default IR for a more specific, punchy British 4x12.

proposals.reason: Enhance upper mids and punch for aggressive lead tones.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the high end.
